'''Star Tours Flight 1138''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]]. It was on time and set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 2B at 0815 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 0910.<ref name="Star Tours: The Adventures Continue">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
"[[1138 (easter egg)|1138]]" is one of many references in ''[[Star Wars]]'' media to the [[George Lucas]] film [[Wikipedia:THX 1138|''THX-1138'']].
